scope: Nearest operator/information/layout precedents checked while the fixed native study ran; not a new model experiment or exhaustive originalitycertification.

items.name: ToMeSD
items.verified: The released patch exposes separate MLP merge/unmerge and adds unmerged FFN output to the original residual. It is not an attention-only precedent.
items.difference_to_test: R14 keeps own frozen affine FFN contrasts in addition to a pooled nonlinear response, rather than broadcasting only the processed merged FFN output. This distinguishes the checked equations, not a proof of originality.
items.fairness: Image StableDiffusion originalconditions, not WanfourstepHiF4. A credible FFN-only adaptation would require identical pre/postQ1 choices, point/row budgets and charged matching/unmerge costs.

items.name: ToMA
items.access: Latestv3fullHTML method4.2/4.3 andappendixF.4; venueabstract; rawvenuePDFfetch failed and was not used asreadPDF.
items.verified: Uses facility-location destination choice, soft linear merge and default transpose unmerge; pseudo-inverse is compared, not the default. Tile/stripe layouts and reuse explicitly target auxiliaryGPUcost.
items.difference_to_test: Neither stripe layout nor GPU-friendly merging is a new feature byitself. The native scientific question is contrast-preserving mean-response fidelity and same-count conditional action value.
items.fairness: SDXL/FLUX settings and hardware differ. Their latency ratios cannot be ordered against R14syntheticA100timing as a head-to-head result.

items.name: DaTMe
items.verified: Ranks merge roles using temporal changes and spatial structure in Tweedie clean estimates. Its documented PixArt setup uses20steps and starts merging atstep2 because the prior estimate is absent initially; FLUX uses35steps.
items.difference_to_test: Causal trajectory information is a real alternate signal family. In a4stepCFG-off student its availability, first-stepfallback, drift and cost must be derived anew. Current R14N0normregistration is unchanged.
items.fairness: No WanHiF4fourstep officialvideo evidence read; no transferable numeric competitiveness claim.

items.name: BiGain
items.verified: Laplacian/frequency scores guide token compression. The described main generation setup keepsMLP/crossattention intact and compresses selfattention; adaptive block averaging is also given.
items.difference_to_test: Protecting high-frequency regions is priorart, not a newimportance insight. Its output geometry and targets differ from preserving per-token FFN contrasts.
items.fairness: Main setups use50stepFP16SD2/DiT withCFG, rather than4stepHiF4Wan. Published improvements cannot substitute for a matched FFN control.
